text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shoes? Check. Outfit? Check. Pocket clover? Check!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My ears and tail are even more lustrous than usual. Let's see, what else?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: As long as there are passionate cheers, everything should unfold swimmingly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm excited… and perfectly itching to go! ♪
choice_data_list: You can do it! Go, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you! ♪ It's time to answer those cheering fans by winning this race!
